meta.name: collecting-indicators-of-compromise
meta.description: Systematically collects, categorizes, and distributes indicators of compromise (IOCs) during and after security incidents to enable detection, blocking, and threat intelligence sharing. Covers network, host, email, and behavioral indicators using STIX/TAXII formats and threat intelligence platforms. Activates for requests involving IOC collection, indicator extraction, threat indicator sharing, compromise indicators, STIX export, or IOC enrichment.

copy.tagline: 收集并分发安全事件中的威胁指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在安全事件后需要系统化收集和共享入侵指标
copy.tagline_en: Collect and distribute threat indicators from security incidents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically collect and share indicators of compromise after a security incident

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会帮你系统收集、分类和分发安全事件中的威胁指标（IOC），包括网络、主机、邮件和行为指标，并支持 STIX/TAXII 格式和威胁情报平台。
howto.when: 当你要求收集 IOC、提取指标、分享威胁指标、导出 STIX 或丰富 IOC 时触发。

say.text: 帮我收集这次 Qakbot 事件的所有 IOC。
say.note: Claude 会从你提供的证据中提取并分类指标。

say.text: 将 IOC 导出为 STIX 2.1 格式。
say.note: Claude 会生成结构化的 STIX JSON 包。

say.text: 丰富这个 IP 185.220.101.42 的威胁情报。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically collects, categorizes, and distributes indicators of compromise (IOCs) from security incidents, covering network, host, email, and behavioral indicators using STIX/TAXII formats and threat intelligence platforms.
howto.when_en: Activates when you request IOC collection, indicator extraction, threat indicator sharing, STIX export, or IOC enrichment.

say_en.text: Collect all IOCs from this Qakbot incident.
say_en.note: Claude extracts and categorizes indicators from your evidence.
Claude generates a structured STIX JSON bundle.
